name: Water and Water-Environment Conservation Activity Grant

funder.name: Dassai Memorial Foundation (獺祭記念財団)

summary: Annual grants of up to JPY 500,000 for grassroots groups working to conserve water and the natural environment through fieldwork, including work that helps solve water problems in developing countries, with environmental education also eligible; applications by post or email.

amount.note: Per project; total budget JPY 2.5 million

reporting: An interim report after six months (around October 2027), then a final activity report and a financial statement (around May 2028).
